records.counting_note: The paper describes 39 Table I runs and reports 19 instances of bends. One Table I row lists two participants under one schedule, and individual participants made repeated runs. The denominator is the number of printed runs.
records.table_ii_note: The Table II BENDS column has 17 Yes and 17 No entries. Thirty-three rows match Table I on date and participant, including some conflicting schedule details. One No row has no Table I counterpart.
records.preoxygenation_delivered_fraction: Depends on the reported stage. Numeric fractions are recorded only when printed.
